item.title: Interface between Human Users and Machine Learning Models in Medical Decision Making
item.content:encoded:
This special issue explores the intersection of human users and machine learning models within medical decision-making contexts. It focuses on understanding how clinicians and other healthcare professionals interact with and utilize machine learning-based systems in their practice, and examines the design and effectiveness of these interfaces in supporting clinical decisions.

Appel publié par Medical Decision Making. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Human-machine interface in medical decision making
  • Machine learning in clinical practice
  • User interaction with ML models
  • Medical decision support systems
